a.lede: A potential deal with Boost Mobile could serve as a shortcut to establishing SpaceX as a mobile carrier.
a.title: SpaceX is reportedly looking at buying Boost Mobile or using its cell network

b.lede: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.
b.title: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
